value.hook: When reviewing anything that consumes pij_harnesses::claude_homes() in the daemon, or Claude home discovery
value.title: PR 341: claude_homes() drops ~/.claude under CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR

sections.name: body
sections.value: PR 341 f7cf59e BLOCK. claude_homes_from: a set CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR REPLACES $HOME/.claude (intended for settings writes). pij-rs daemon bounce inherits the caller env (no env_clear), so a bounce from a cc-alt Claude seat gives the daemon homes without ~/.claude. Any daemon consumer of claude_homes() (UdsTransport since #341, claude_bind) must add $HOME/.claude itself. Security held: pid+start checked per home, token read from the record's own dir, cross-home ambiguity refuses. Mutants M1-M3 killed via git archive + shared-build run from the archive dir.
